text: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id, di.efo_term AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE di.max_phase_for_ind = 4 AND LOWER(di.efo_term) LIKE '%schizophrenia%'
